name: openvoxel
description: A teaching voxel world built from first principles with VelarScript.

scripts.generate: npm run generate --workspace @openvoxel/identities && npm run generate --workspace @openvoxel/blocks && npm run generate --workspace @openvoxel/world-generation && npm run generate --workspace @openvoxel/renderer && npm run generate --workspace @openvoxel/web
scripts.generate:check: npm run generate:check --workspace @openvoxel/identities && npm run generate:check --workspace @openvoxel/blocks && npm run generate:check --workspace @openvoxel/world-generation && npm run generate:check --workspace @openvoxel/renderer && npm run generate:check --workspace @openvoxel/web
scripts.test:gpu: npm run generate && npm run test:gpu --workspace @openvoxel/renderer
scripts.validate:static: npm run generate && npm run generate:check && npm run structure:check && npm run test:structure && npm run format:check && npm run check && npm test && npm run build
scripts.validate:browser: npm run test:gpu && npm run test:web-ui
scripts.validate: npm run validate:static && npm run validate:browser
